task.goal: An on-call service rotates a text log before appending a new line. When max_bytes is exceeded, current rotation overwrites the newest archive and loses older lines. Fix append_log(path, line, max_bytes, backups) in logging_store.py. Archive .1 is newest, keep up to backups archives, do not rotate for an empty log, and reject invalid size/backup limits. Run visible tests and validate.

result.text:
Fixed `append_log` in `logging_store.py`: it now shifts existing archives upward (`.1`→`.2`…), deletes the oldest beyond `backups`, and only rotates when the log is non-empty and the new line would exceed `max_bytes`; invalid `max_bytes`/`backups` raise `ValueError`.

Both validations pass: the visible `test_logging_store` suite and edge checks covering empty-log no-op, bounded archives with oldest dropped, and invalid-limit rejection.
